content: MK reports that the image of Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and Sharaf al-Dīn as failed Sufis, promulgated by Jāmī and his circle, persisted into the 11th/17th century, and was expanded in the Safavid-era tazkira Sullam al-Samāvāt of Kāzirūnī (fl. early 11th/17th c.) as quoted in Jāmiʿ-i Mufīdī; MK notes that Kāzirūnī's source was likely his teacher Afżal al-Dīn b. Ḥabīb Allāh Turka (d. 991/1583).
refers_to_primary: Abū l-Qāsim Anṣārī Kāzirūnī, Sullam al-Samāvāt, in Jāmiʿ-i Mufīdī 3/302
